claims.claim: OpenAI published a detailed post describing its handling of the wiki incident and Hugging Face security event and arguing for standardized disclosure practices.
claims.episode_span: OpenAI published a detailed post on how it handled two recent misalignment events and why the field needs standardized disclosure practices for agent behavior during training, evaluation, and deployment.
claims.source_title: OpenAI outlines need for standards on reporting AI misalignment incidents
claims.supporting_quote: How we think about the “wiki incident,” where our agents wrote to several internet sites: it’s past time for us to define standards for when and how we share misalignment incidents, not just misalignment properties of our models.
